name: Stonetide Anvilknot Ore
description: A dense ore shot through with tidal compression seams.
specialEffects: Used in breaker-head castings, heavy maces, and impact-focused smithing.

steps: Refine raw stock for Stonetide Anvilknot Ore under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Stonetide Refinery protocol before storage.
